name: Rule feed monitor
job: Watches eCFR and regulator sites, pulls the official text

name: Section splitter
job: Splits a rule into numbered sections and checks the official outline

name: Scope checker
job: Decides whether a rule applies to this bank, from the bank's facts

name: Duty finder
job: Proposes each duty with the exact sentence it came from

name: Quote check
job: Confirms the quoted sentence and clause exist in the source

name: Duty reviewer
job: Second opinion on every proposed duty; can hold one back

name: Duty finaliser
job: Sets each accepted duty's deadline and merges duplicates

name: Coverage mapper
job: Matches each duty to policy sections, procedure steps and controls

name: Drift detector
job: Finds where a policy and its procedure disagree on a number

name: Position calculator
job: Counts covered, not yet confirmed, nothing behind it, known gaps

name: Impact assessor
job: Walks everything a rule change touches, including vendors

name: Control designer
job: Suggests the smallest fix and drafts the control and policy words

name: Design checker
job: Tests a draft control against the seven design checks

name: Ask Madison
job: Answers questions from the bank's record, with citations
